name: scroll
js: new Promise(res => { const ys = []; let jumps = 0, last = 0; const target = document.querySelector('#reviews').getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY - 62; let y = 0; const step = () => { y += 40; scrollTo(0, y); requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (Math.abs(scrollY - y) > 2) jumps++; if (y < target) step(); else setTimeout(() => res({ jumps, end: scrollY, active: [...document.querySelectorAll('.rp-tabs a.on')].map(a => a.textContent) }), 600); }); }; step(); })
